messages:
ria_ops: Quick flag  presenter mic cut out for ~10s during the roadmap Q at 11:22. Slides also jumped a couple pages. Live stream stayed up but audience asked in chat if recording will have that section. @tom can you check the room feed and record host?

tom: Looking. House mic went silent; swapped presenter to lav mic at 11:22:15 and resumed. OBS shows slide deck lost remote control focus for two advance attempts — probably USB HID hiccup.

anya: I pulled /var/log/record06: saw `usb 1-3: reset high-speed USB device number 8` at 2026-03-26T11:22:13Z then `recorderd` logged gap for two segments.

obs-bot: obs: scene remained live. deck-control: reconnected remote at 11:22:18Z. Fallback slides advanced manually.

infra-bot: infra-alert: record06 reported two short segment gaps; no disk errors. Recommend marking partials and uploading full iso.

ria_ops: Tom, can you rsync the recorded segments and mark the 11:22:10-11:22:25 window as partial? Also capture presenter clip if available.

tom: Running `rsync --partial /mnt/recordings/record06/ s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record06/2026-03-26/` now. Will flag `partial-` files and post link when done.

jen (CEO): Keep running the session. Collect missed audience Qs and we'll answer top ones at the end. Please loop Comms once uploads are live.

qa-lyn: I'll harvest the chat and live Q sheet. Noting one audience Q at 11:21:58 asking "will the migration impact client SLAs?" Adding to follow-ups.

comm-lou: Once you have the S3 link I'll post a short note: "Recording is available; a brief ~15s segment around 11:22 may be incomplete. Full transcript will be shared."

ria_ops: Thanks. Action items: 1) tom: upload spliced segments + iso to S3 and tag partials (ASAP), 2) ria_ops: postmortem draft by EOD, 3) qa-lyn: compile missed Qs within 45m, 4) infra to investigate USB/recorder resilience. If anyone needs local clips preserved, drop S3 paths here. :white_check_mark:
